gamerule.bd_archetypes_enabled.descripti: Whether tamed wolves gain specialized canine personality archetypes upon taming.
0=Evenly distributed across all 6 archetypes, 1=Heavy Guardian bias, 2=Adventurer/Playful bias.
betterdogs.archetype.guardian.desc: Stays steadfast near home and pack members with boosted defensive toughness.
betterdogs.archetype.playful.desc: Loves fetching sticks, social play, and energetic tail wagging.
betterdogs.archetype.hunter.desc: Heightened scent tracking and swift, decisive predatory strikes.
betterdogs.archetype.cowardly.desc: Easily startled by dangerous mobs, quick to retreat and stay close to owner.
betterdogs.archetype.lazy.desc: Relaxed and leisurely; enjoys sitting down and lounging when nothing is happening.
betterdogs.archetype.adventurer.desc: Eager explorer; roams wider, navigates obstacles swiftly, and loves the open wild.
betterdogs.archetype.fearless.desc: Undaunted in combat; stands ground against ignited creepers and terrifying beasts.
